A '''pupusa''' is a stuffed flatbread that heals {{Hp|3}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pupusa.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, [[cheese]], [[oil]] and a [[cooked porkchop]] or [[cooked chicken]] make 4. Crafting returns the oil's glass bottle. No advancement unlocks the recipe, so it never appears in the recipe book, although the 1.10 changelog lists its unlock as fixed.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a pupusa takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|3}}.
